errors.evidence: The description fails to link the category labels (the years) to their corresponding visual attributes (colors and values). It lists the colors and values, and then separately lists the years, without specifying which year corresponds to which slice. For example, it does not state that the blue segment represents 2019.

The description uses the word "möglicherweise" (possibly) to describe the ordering of segments by size. The segments are definitively arranged by size in descending order, so this word introduces unnecessary uncertainty.
